node.title: C1 relation-side norm sandwich: doubling embedding squares Norm, AM-GM ceiling w^(N/2), saturating weights {1,2,3,7}, unconditional router threshold
node.statement: In Z[x]/(x^N+1), N a power of two, for ternary f of weight w with Norm(f)=Res(f,x^N+1): (i) g(x)->g(x^2) preserves ternariness/weight and squares the norm, so maxnorm(N,w) >= maxnorm(N/2,w)^2; (ii) 1 <= Norm(f) <= w^(N/2) for nonzero f (conjugate-pair product, negacyclic Parseval, AM-GM; positivity from irreducibility of x^N+1); (iii) maxnorm(N,w) = w^(N/2) for w in {1,2,3} at every N >= 4 and w = 7 at every N >= 8, by exhaustive base cases at N=4,8 plus the (i)/(ii) sandwich induction; (iv) any admissible prime q == 1 (mod 2N) with q > w^(N/2) carries no ternary relation of weight <= w (via the banked relation-side resultant router); at 2N=8 the exceptional census is empty (maxnorm 9 < 17). The stable-range doubling law below w = N/2 remains a conjecture (imprimitivity), NOT claimed here. Provenance notes/pilots_20260802/c1_norm_ladder/.
